yaw_input_contract: All requested yaw inputs use [0,2pi); quaternion reconstructed from each Euler triplet is the original generated physical attitude.
attitude_method: Stratified physical body-z tilt, random tilt-axis bearing, random yaw; yaw represented on the full training input interval [0,2pi).
initial_success_band_rejection: Reject only if initial position-error norm<0.3m AND initial speed norm<0.3m/s.
selection: Fixed seeded state bank; no policy outcomes used.
endpoint: 10s complete; all last2s observations position error<0.3m and speed<0.3m/s; earlier relapse allowed.
